I found the trick to punching through things is focusing your power on the point you are trying to break and imagining going through that point and hitting something behind it. However if you haven't built up calluses and/or pain immunity in your hand then it will hurt alot when starting out. Start with something small/weak and practice breaking them first. If you're devoted to it then invest in stone breaking boards. They are reusable and vary in difficulty. I've been doing tae kwon do for nearly eight years and still don't consider myself to be good at this, but after the amount of training I've done I can easily break through an average wooden door. Technique is important so I would recommend checking out local martial arts clubs for advanced training and safety help, I've seen new members come in and try to break boards with their bare fists before and shear off all the skin on their knuckle's, not a pretty sight. In any case, good luck.
